notes: Confusables: overwhelm-breakdown (one step for momentum), agent-orchestration (build phases), experiment-designer (one test), hemlock (whether to build).
should_trigger: What order should I tackle this in?
The idea checks out — now what's the right order to do things in?
Rank these assumptions by risk and tell me which to test first.
My roadmap builds the whole thing before we test anything. Reorder it.
Put kill-gates between the experiments and order them cheapest-decisive first.
Which of these need validating before we write any product code?
Order these steps so nothing gets built ahead of the test that justifies it.
should_not_trigger: I'm overwhelmed by this project — just give me one step for today.
Should I build this at all, or does something already do it?
Design a single experiment with a pass/fail threshold fixed up front.
Coordinate design, implementation, and deployment as one workflow.
Write a post-mortem for the project we just sunset.
